topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: Full its-magic lifecycle burns too many tokens (~11 subagent spawns + heavy docs per story). Operator wants ultra-lean and mega-quick delivery modes achieving ~50-70% token reduction at near-same code quality, activatable via scratchpad, without destroying standard mode behavior.

Cursor IDE its-magic kit in installed downstream repos; merged .cursor/scratchpad.md; /auto orchestration per auto-orchestration-reference.md; optional full_autonomy native chain (US-0095) composes unchanged.

Markdown slash commands, JSON pack.json artifacts, Python stdlib validators and phase-plan resolver extensions, contract tests in tests/auto_command_contract_test.py; compose on US-0053 narrow-read, US-0080 token metrics, DEC-0052 phase selection.

New DELIVERY_MODE axis controls lifecycle shape and artifacts; TOKEN_PROFILE remains context breadth only (DEC-0062); CAVEMAN_MODE remains reply voice (DEC-0072). Layered memory: hot index + pack.json + section-scoped cold reads of vision/architecture/decisions - not amnesia.

Scratchpad keys DELIVERY_MODE=standard|ultra_lean|mega_quick (default standard); optional LEAN_MEMORY_* tuning; optional backlog per-story delivery_mode routing; operator selects mode per run or per story class (greenfield vs bugfix).

Lean modes must not bypass tests, secrets deny-list, or publish without RELEASE_PUBLISH_MODE; standard mode gates (US-0039, US-0048, US-0056, US-0069) unchanged when DELIVERY_MODE=standard; lean modes use compact evidence hashes instead of verbose isolation tuples but retain auditable refs.

Target ~50% cache-read reduction for ultra_lean and ~70%+ for mega_quick on comparable runs (DEC-0062 run_class_hash); code quality preserved via AC-before-code, test loop, conditional arch/vision deltas; universal wins ship without mode toggle.

Single story US-0096 with tranches: A universal token wins (always on), B ultra_lean four macro-phases + pack.json, C mega_quick /auto routing, D optional backlog routing; standard its-magic byte-compatible at default.
